sourceNotes: Values are approximate representative placeholders for ruleset tuning, not a clinical nutrient database.

sections.title: Fats
sections.narration: 49.0 grams of fat. Polyunsaturated fat is 20.7 grams, helping with cell structure and healthy signalling. Omega 3 is 100 milligrams, not adding much omega 3, so that's a real downside for seeds. For seeds, fat quality is a big reason to use them.

sections.title: Carbs
sections.narration: 10.7 grams of carbs. Sugar is 1.4 grams, helping keep the sugar load under control. Fibre is 6 grams, with only modest fullness and digestion support, so that's a small downside for seeds. For seeds, fibre matters much more than raw carb totals.

sections.title: Proteins
sections.narration: 30.2 grams of protein. That amount is useful enough to count. Essential amino acids score is 9 out of 9, making the protein useful for repair and maintenance, and it is still a strong secondary mark. For seeds, protein is a bonus here, but not enough by itself.
